impact.headline: 6 builds rescheduled. 54 customer deliveries affected at 26 dealers; 10 Platinum/Gold customers got a loaner, 2 entitled customers are waiting (dealer pool empty).
changed: 6 production orders moved (4 same-plant reschedules, 2 transfers); 4 now build later (avg 3.0 days), 2 earlier at another plant.
26 dealers told about exactly their affected orders (one message each); 10 loaners assigned.
unchanged: 3 other orders at P_AL in the delay window (2027-03-29 to 2027-04-01) build models without CAM-360 (['NOVA']), so they were not moved.
54 of 60 future production orders at P_AL were not affected and were not moved.
42 Standard-tier customers: dealer informed, no loaner (policy rule 5).
2 entitled customers did not get a loaner because the dealer's pool ran out: ['CO-02568', 'CO-02644']
24 dealers have no affected orders and were not contacted.
No lots held, no vehicles stopped from sale (not part of a delay or outage).
